title: My Models
description: Per-user view of training pipelines and deployed models. Every query is scoped to the signed-in user through ${__user.login} -> users.username -> the owner of the repository or project.

panels.title: My projects
panels.description: Active projects owned by the signed-in user.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "projects"
FROM projects pr
JOIN users u ON u.id = pr.owner_id
WHERE u.username = '${__user.login}'
  AND pr.is_active;

panels.title: Deployed models
panels.description: Distinct model names currently active, deployed from the user's own pipelines.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.model_name) AS "models"
FROM model_deployments d
JOIN pipelines p ON p.id = d.pipeline_id
JOIN repositories r ON r.id = p.repo_id
JOIN users u ON u.id = r.owner_id
WHERE u.username = '${__user.login}'
  AND d.is_active;

panels.title: Last metric
panels.description: The most recent successful run's deciding metric: the one its project deploys on, or accuracy when the run did not log it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.finished_at AS "time",
  m.name AS metric,
  (p.metrics->>m.name)::float AS value
FROM pipelines p
JOIN repositories r ON r.id = p.repo_id
LEFT JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = p.project_id
JOIN users u ON u.id = r.owner_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p.metrics->>(pr.deploy_policy->>'metric') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$'
    THEN pr.deploy_policy->>'metric'
    ELSE 'accuracy'
  END AS name
) m
WHERE u.username = '${__user.login}'
  AND p.status = 'success'
  AND p.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND p.metrics->>m.name ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$'
ORDER BY p.finished_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Pipeline success rate
panels.description: Successful runs over finished runs (success + failed) in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'success')
         / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status IN ('success', 'failed')), 0)
       , 1) AS "success_rate"
FROM pipelines p
JOIN repositories r ON r.id = p.repo_id
JOIN users u ON u.id = r.owner_id
WHERE u.username = '${__user.login}'
  AND p.started_at IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(p.started_at);

panels.title: Deciding metric over time (per project)
panels.description: Each project's deciding metric for every successful run: the one it deploys on, or accuracy when the run did not log it. Runs older than projects are named by their repository.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.finished_at AS "time",
  COALESCE(pr.name, r.github_url) || ' @ ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(p.branch, ''), pr.branch) || ' (' || m.name || ')' AS metric,
  (p.metrics->>m.name)::float AS value
FROM pipelines p
JOIN repositories r ON r.id = p.repo_id
LEFT JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = p.project_id
JOIN users u ON u.id = r.owner_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p.metrics->>(pr.deploy_policy->>'metric') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$'
    THEN pr.deploy_policy->>'metric'
    ELSE 'accuracy'
  END AS name
) m
WHERE u.username = '${__user.login}'
  AND p.status = 'success'
  AND p.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND p.metrics->>m.name ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$'
  AND $__timeFilter(p.finished_at)
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Deciding metric by branch
panels.description: Average and best value of the deciding metric per branch, so an AI-suggested branch can be compared against main. Best is the lowest for a metric where lower is better.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(p.branch, ''), pr.branch) || ' (' || m.name || ')' AS "branch",
  ROUND(AVG((p.metrics->>m.name)::numeric), 4) AS "average",
  ROUND(
    CASE
      WHEN bool_or(m.lower) THEN MIN((p.metrics->>m.name)::numeric)
      ELSE MAX((p.metrics->>m.name)::numeric)
    END, 4
  ) AS "best",
  COUNT(*) AS "runs"
FROM pipelines p
JOIN repositories r ON r.id = p.repo_id
LEFT JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = p.project_id
JOIN users u ON u.id = r.owner_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN p.metrics->>(pr.deploy_policy->>'metric') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$'
      THEN pr.deploy_policy->>'metric'
      ELSE 'accuracy'
    END AS name,
    COALESCE(
      p.metrics->>(pr.deploy_policy->>'metric') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$'
      AND pr.deploy_policy->>'direction' = 'lower',
      FALSE
    ) AS lower
) m
WHERE u.username = '${__user.login}'
  AND p.status = 'success'
  AND p.metrics->>m.name ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$'
  AND p.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(p.finished_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Pipeline outcomes
panels.description: Successful vs failed (and still running) pipeline runs in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.status AS "status",
  COUNT(*) AS "runs"
FROM pipelines p
JOIN repositories r ON r.id = p.repo_id
JOIN users u ON u.id = r.owner_id
WHERE u.username = '${__user.login}'
  AND p.started_at IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Average pipeline duration
panels.description: Mean finished_at - started_at per time bucket, for the user's finished pipelines.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(p.started_at, $__interval),
  AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.finished_at - p.started_at))) AS "avg_duration"
FROM pipelines p
JOIN repositories r ON r.id = p.repo_id
JOIN users u ON u.id = r.owner_id
WHERE u.username = '${__user.login}'
  AND p.started_at IS NOT NULL
  AND p.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND p.finished_at >= p.started_at
  AND $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
